cards.text: Israel is camped on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho, with Canaan right across the river. Then the LORD gives Moses, Israel's leader, a message for the people about the day they cross over. That's smelling the cookies through the oven door, friend.

cards.question: When Israel crosses into Canaan, what does the LORD say to do about the people living there?
The people of Canaan have carved images and cast idols. The LORD tells Israel to ___ them all.
True or false: The LORD says Israel can leave the high places in Canaan standing.

cards.text: Next, the LORD says to take possession of the land and settle in it. Friend, I lived in a junk drawer for years and never possessed so much as a corner of it.

cards.question: Why does the LORD say Israel can take possession of Canaan?

answers.text: He has given them the land

cards.text: Now, who gets which piece? Splitting one land between all of Israel's clans? If you've ever tried to plan anything in a family group chat, you know that could get LOUD.

cards.question: How does the LORD say the land will be divided among Israel's clans?
True or false: When the land is divided, a larger clan gets a larger inheritance, and a smaller clan gets a smaller one.

cards.text: "Whatever falls to each one by lot will be his." Then the LORD adds a warning with a big IF: what if Israel doesn't drive everyone out?

cards.question: The LORD says the people Israel allows to remain will ___ them in the land where they settle.

cards.text: And He paints the picture: those people will become "barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides" if they stay. Friend, I got ONE cookie crumb in my eye once and stamped crooked for a whole batch.

cards.question: If Israel lets those people stay, what does the LORD say He will then do?

answers.text: Do to Israel what He planned to do to them
Send Israel back into the wilderness
Give Israel a smaller piece of the land

cards.text: Then the LORD gives Moses the borders of Canaan, all four sides. The south runs from the Wilderness of Zin, the west is the coast of the Great Sea, the north runs inland from the Great Sea to Hazar-enan, and the east comes down the Jordan to the Salt Sea. In the LORD's words, "This will be your land, defined by its borders on all sides."
So Moses passes it on: divide this land by lot as an inheritance, for nine and a half tribes. Nine and a HALF. I had to read that one twice too, friend.

cards.question: Why does Moses say the land in Canaan goes to nine and a half tribes?

answers.text: The other tribes already have their land
The other tribes chose to stay in Egypt
The other tribes were too small to count

cards.question: True or false: The tribes of Reuben and Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh received their inheritance across the Jordan from Jericho, toward the sunrise.

cards.text: Then the LORD names the two men who will assign the land. One is Aaron's son, now the priest (Numbers 20:28), and the other has been Moses' assistant since he was young (Numbers 11:28).

cards.question: Who are the two men the LORD names to assign the land?
Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun won't do it alone. The LORD tells Moses to appoint one leader from each ___ to help distribute the land.

cards.text: Then the LORD lists them by name, ten leaders from ten tribes, the ones He commanded to hand out the inheritance in Canaan. First up is Caleb son of Jephunneh from Judah, the spy who once said Israel could take this land (Numbers 13:30). Now he's on the list to hand it out. Friend, that's the best told-you-so in history.
